description: A family provision claim: putting the executor's solicitors on notice is a letter of demand to them

matter.title: Tessa Marlowe: Estate of Desmond Marlowe

query: Tessa has signed the costs agreement. Let's put the executor's solicitors on notice of her claim.
answer: Moorabool Legal act for the executor, Graham Marlowe. A letter of demand to them would put the estate on notice of Tessa's family provision claim and ask that nothing be distributed while it is outstanding.
